description:
Spotify Trust & Safety is dedicated to creating a platform that’s safe for users and creators and true to our values.

We’re looking for an Associate Ad Review Specialist Contractor to join our Monetization Operations team within Trust & Safety. You’ll support day-to-day ad review operations and policy enforcement, respond to inquiries and escalations from sales and cross-functional partners, and help maintain strong feedback loops across operations, policy, sales, and vendor teams. Your work will help ensure Spotify remains a safe and positive experience for everyone.

Please note that this is a fixed-term, 6-month contractor role hired through a third party.

lists.content:
• Review ad submissions and podcasts on Spotify to ensure they comply with Spotify’s policies.
  • Manage review queues in line with SLAs and prioritization guidance.
  • Triage and handle time-sensitive escalations from internal and external partners, including sales, advertisers, and vendor teams.
  • Identify and escalate emerging trends, operational gaps, and high-risk content to the appropriate partners and leadership.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to improve enforcement workflows, escalation processes, and tooling.
  • Support quality assurance initiatives through hands-on QA, error reporting, feedback, and root cause analysis.

• You have a BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have a minimum of 1+ years of operational experience in ad review, content moderation, brand safety, or a related area.
  • You work effectively both independently and collaboratively and are comfortable taking ownership of your work.
  • You communicate clearly and thoughtfully with different stakeholders; experience working with sales teams or vendors is helpful.
  • You can navigate complex issues, manage your time, and prioritize competing assignments effectively.
  • You care about protecting Spotify’s brand, users, creators, and wider community.
  • You have flexibility to work assigned shifts, which may include early mornings, late evenings, and weekends. Some weekend or holiday on-call coverage may be required.
  • You are comfortable reviewing content that may be sensitive or disturbing as part of your work.

• This role is based in Singapore
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators.


Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts.
Our Advertising Product & Technology team is building the next generation advertising platform for audio and video at Spotify. We create thoughtful, non-interruptive ad experiences that power free listening for hundreds of millions of fans around the world. From display to video, our work lives across some of the most highly trafficked surfaces in the app—helping connect listeners, creators, and advertisers in meaningful ways.

lists.content:
• Build and evolve ad experiences that allow millions of listeners to enjoy Spotify for free
  • Collaborate with engineers across Android, iOS, backend, and web, along with product, design, and data partners to ship impactful features
  • Write clean, maintainable code that scales across teams and products
  • Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and best practices for Android development within Advertising
  • Improve app performance, reliability, and user experience across ad surfaces
  • Help shape reusable components and libraries that support fast, consistent development
  • Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and autonomous team environment

• You know how to write clear, idiomatic Kotlin or Java and build maintainable Android applications
  • You are experienced with modern Android frameworks and development tools
  • You have a strong understanding of Android architecture patterns and API design
  • You care about code quality, performance, and delivering polished user experiences
  • You understand how mobile applications connect with backend systems end-to-end
  • You have shipped at least one app to the Google Play Store or have a project you can walk us through
  • You value collaboration and contribute to a positive, inclusive team environment
  • You have 2+ years of experience building Android applications

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the Americas region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.
